id.description: Must match the app's own aw-app.json manifest id.

repo.description: Repo path (owner/name) or full git URL where the app's code + aw-app.json live.

ref.description: Tag, branch, or commit to pin install to. Defaults to the repo's default branch when omitted.

version.description: Optional semver pin, matched against the app's own aw-app.json version field.

signed.description: Whether this catalog entry is trusted to receive high-risk capabilities during install.

has_config.description: Whether the app has a config/settings window to open post-install.

bootstrap.description: Whether installing this app runs a bootstrap/install hook.

publisher.description: Override for the app's own aw-app.json publisher field (normally merged in server-side by the catalog endpoint).

resource_estimate.description: Override for the app's own aw-app.json resource_estimate field (normally merged in server-side by the catalog endpoint).
